name: George Orwell
bio: English novelist and essayist known for dystopian works exploring surveillance, authoritarianism, and political ideology.

name: Harper Lee
bio: American novelist best known for exploring racial injustice and moral growth in the American South.

name: J.K. Rowling
bio: British author famous for the Harry Potter fantasy series, one of the best-selling book franchises in history.

name: J.R.R. Tolkien
bio: English writer and philologist who created the high-fantasy world of Middle-earth.

name: F. Scott Fitzgerald
bio: American novelist associated with the Jazz Age, known for portraying wealth, ambition, and disillusionment.

name: Jane Austen
bio: English novelist celebrated for romantic fiction that critiques social class and relationships.

name: Dan Brown
bio: American thriller writer known for fast-paced mystery novels blending history, religion, and conspiracy.

name: Paulo Coelho
bio: Brazilian novelist whose philosophical fiction explores destiny, spirituality, and personal discovery.

name: Suzanne Collins
bio: American author known for dystopian young adult fiction examining power, survival, and media influence.

name: Markus Zusak
bio: Australian writer recognized for emotionally powerful historical fiction narratives.

name: Khaled Hosseini
bio: Afghan-American novelist whose works explore family, exile, and redemption.

name: Mary Shelley
bio: English novelist and pioneer of science fiction, best known for gothic storytelling.

name: Bram Stoker
bio: Irish author famous for gothic horror literature and vampire mythology.

name: Herman Melville
bio: American novelist known for symbolic and philosophical maritime fiction.

name: Leo Tolstoy
bio: Russian writer regarded as one of the greatest novelists, known for epic historical narratives.
